quotes.text: If my love for you were written across the stars, the universe would run out of sky before I could finish telling you how much you mean to me.
Even if I traveled across every galaxy and counted every star in the universe, I’d still never find anything as beautiful as you.
Diamonds may be the rarest gems, and gold may be the most precious treasure, but no jewel in this world could ever shine as brightly or be worth as much as you are to me.
If every beautiful thing in this world were a word, and every sunset, flower, and star were a verse, the universe would still run out of poetry trying to describe you.

If the whole world turned against you, I’d stand between you and every storm. If darkness ever found its way to your heart, I’d become your light. And if forever were a promise, I’d spend every lifetime proving that you’ll always have a safe place in my arms and a permanent home in my heart.
If beauty could stop time, the world would stand still every time you smiled. And if love could be measured, even eternity wouldn’t be long enough to show you how much you mean to me.
Somewhere along the way, a piece of my heart became yours, and I hope you keep it forever, because nowhere else could it ever feel more at home.
You’re the air that fills my lungs, the water that keeps me alive, and the food that gives me strength. You’re not just a part of my life, you’re what makes it worth living.

If you were a book, I’d read you a thousand times, knowing every word by heart, yet never growing tired of turning the pages, because something written as perfectly as you deserves to be loved over and over again.
